zapier_oauth2.description: OAuth2 Authorization Code. The `event_id` (Event API Key) is supplied at authorize time and binds the token to one event.

info.description:
Endpoints consumed by the published TktPlz Zapier app. One OAuth connection = one event: the Event API Key is bound to the access token at authorize time and echoed on every request via the `X-Event-ID` header.

**Authentication** — OAuth2 Authorization Code. The Event API Key (`event_id`) is found in TktPlz admin → select event → More Settings → Third Party Apps (format `api-` + 32 chars).

**Idempotency** — write requests (POST/PATCH) carry an `Idempotency-Key`; identical retries do not create duplicates (a 409 is treated as success).

**Rate limits** — 60 requests/minute per connection. Throttled requests return 429 with a `Retry-After` header (seconds).

**Webhook delivery** (API → Zapier) is signed `X-Webhook-Signature: sha256=` (HMAC-SHA256 of the raw body); missing/mismatched signatures are rejected.
info.title: Zapier API V1

get.description: Custom registration fields for a category. Pass `category_id` (Create Guest) or `guest_id` (Update Guest — category resolved server-side). In Zapier these keys are namespaced `cf__` and grouped under `custom_fields` on write.
Validates the token + event scope and returns a human-readable connection label (`{event_name} @ {tenant_name}`).
